text_block_list.text:
It's a calm mid-February afternoon, and
I'm
dozing off under the sun's warm light.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer.

Mihono Bourbon gives me some
Valentine's Day
chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on your expression, I detect
"surprise" from
you. May I ask why?

I never would've thought that the
ever-serious
Mihono Bourbon would
take note of something
like Valentine's
Day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My mother and I used to give a gift to
my father
every year. Valentine's Day is
a tradition in my
family.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Now then, I will take my leave.

She went through the trouble of getting
me the
present, so I want to thank her
properly. I hurry
and open the package...

And find chocolates that have been
individually
wrapped with great care.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate shop had so many
varieties that
coming to a decision
proved difficult.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I made my selections based on a wide
array of
data, including your current
circumstances,
tastes, and the level of
humidity.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I prepared a selection of chocolates with
high
cocoa content and a low glycemic
index. The
blending ratio is seventy-two
percent, and the
sweetness level is
"mild."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
They're said to provide various benefits,
including
lowering blood pressure,
beautification, and
boosting cognitive
function.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
They also contain caffeine, which is
helpful in
keeping you alert on sleepy
afternoons.

I eat one and a mild sweetness spreads

throughout my mouth. Somehow, I feel
more
energized.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Uh, I... You are very welcome, Trainer.

I make smooth progress in my work in
the
afternoon!

There are several heart-shaped
chocolates inside.

I take a bite, and a gentle, bittersweet
flavor fills
my mouth.

It tastes a little different from something
you'd
buy from a store, and I notice a
slight grainy
texture on my tongue.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Correct. They are handmade.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I intended to purchase premade
chocolates, but
search results showed
that the handmade variety
would
provide greater happiness to the
recipient.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I started with raw cacao beans
because I
was very particular about the
extent to which
these chocolates were
made by hand.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. My original intention was to
start by
planting the seeds...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But apparently they take four years from
planting
to harvest, so I abandoned that
idea.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was quite confident in my physical
abilities,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The process of "conching," in which the
chocolate
is stirred manually for
seventy-two hours, was
somewhat
difficult.

Looking more closely, I can see that
Mihono
Bourbon is somewhat exhausted.

I feel an even greater level of
appreciation for
the chocolates she gave
me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In that case... I feel... "elated."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, it's fine. They're all for you.
Grooooowl...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Stomach contractions due to hunger
have been
detected. It appears that I
have not eaten
anything in seventy-two
hours.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: B-but I made them for you to eat...

Though she is being surprisingly difficult
about it,
I eventually manage to
convince Mihono Bourbon
to share the
treats with me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Status—"extremely satisfied!".
